description: This file defines a Translator class for handling internationalization, including adding translations, locale data, and performing translations with support for pluralization. It imports external modules and types, and exports the Translator class.

classes.name: Translator
classes.description: A class for managing translations, adding locale data, and performing translation operations with support for pluralization.

methods.name: addTranslation
methods.description: Adds a single translation key with associated texts, with a warning if overriding existing key.

methods.name: addTranslations
methods.description: Adds multiple translations from an object, with validation and warning for invalid input.

methods.name: addLocaleData
methods.description: Adds locale-specific translation data, defaulting to English if locale data is missing.

methods.name: translate
methods.description: Translates a string key with optional arguments, with error handling.

methods.name: translateWithNumber
methods.description: Performs plural-aware translation based on a number argument, with error handling.
